⬇ Download Hifazat Block
v5.0.0 · APK · Android 8+

Hifazat Block is a free Android app for blocking distracting apps, filtering adult content, and setting daily usage limits, scheduled blocking windows, and focus sessions.

To do this, it asks for Accessibility and Device Admin permissions — these let it detect and block apps/content, and stop itself from being disabled while a block you started is still active. It also runs a local VPN for content filtering (no data leaves your device). No account or sign-up required.

After you download

1
Open the downloaded file and tap Install. If a warning screen appears, tap Install anyway.
2
Open Hifazat Block and allow every permission it asks for.
3
Turn on Accessibility when the app asks, so blocking actually works.
Having trouble installing? The app will walk you through every remaining step with short videos, right when you need them.
